title: Error Response (Public API)
description: Standard error response format for public API (§51, ADR-0002)

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code (§51). See contracts/README.md for catalog and HTTP statuses.

message.description: Human-readable message; frontend does not parse this (§51).

details.description: Error details (format depends on code). For VALIDATION_ERROR: fields object (field name → array of messages). For IMAGE_ALREADY_EXISTS: existing_image_id.
